{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: 🛠️ Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "src/data.yaml"
      - "src/data.schema.json"
      - "dist/data.json"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: projectdiscovery/actions/setup/ajv@v1
      - run: make compile
      - run: make test

  duplicate-domains:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run duplicate domains check
        id: duplicate_check
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          make duplicate-domains | tee duplicate-domains.log
          echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ -s duplicate-domains.log ]; then
            echo "has_output=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            {
              echo "body<<EOF"
              echo "## Duplicate Domain Check"
              echo
              echo "Duplicate domains were found during the check:"
              echo
              echo '```text'
              head -c 60000 duplicate-domains.log
              echo
              echo '```'
              echo "EOF"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_output=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Comment on PR for duplicate domains
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.duplicate_check.outputs.has_output == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          COMMENT_BODY: ${{ steps.duplicate_check.outputs.body }}
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: process.env.COMMENT_BODY
            })
      - name: Fail when duplicate check fails
        if: steps.duplicate_check.outputs.exit_code != '0'
        run: exit 1

  validate-domains:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: projectdiscovery/actions/setup/go@v1
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-mod-${{ hashFiles('go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-mod-
      - name: Run validate domains check
        id: validate_check
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          make validate-domains | tee validate-domains.log
          echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ -s validate-domains.log ]; then
            echo "has_output=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            {
              echo "body<<EOF"
              echo "## Validate Domains Check"
              echo
              echo "Invalid domains were found during the check:"
              echo
              echo '```text'
              head -c 60000 validate-domains.log
              echo
              echo '```'
              echo "EOF"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_output=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Comment on PR for invalid domains
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.validate_check.outputs.has_output == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          COMMENT_BODY: ${{ steps.validate_check.outputs.body }}
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: process.env.COMMENT_BODY
            })
      - name: Fail when validate check fails
        if: steps.validate_check.outputs.exit_code != '0'
        run: exit 1",
  "rationale": "The validate-domains job repeatedly downloads and compiles Go module dependencies (go run ./cmd/validate-domains/main.go) on every PR run with no existing dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by the literature report, which reports modest aggregate VM-time savings (free 6%, paid 3.4%) for dependency caching. Its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable across PR runs, and the repository provides a lockfile (go.sum) to key the cache. No contraindications apply: there is no equivalent cache already present, and the Go module cache is content-addressed/trusted. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on hashFiles('go.sum') preserves all build and test coverage, adds no privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access, and is a minimal, safe change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
